title: Week 3: @ Browns (Bryce balls out in Falcons win + Tony Grossi joins the show)
text: The Charlotte Observer's Carolina Panthers columnist Scott Fowler and producer Zach Dennis talk about the team's Week 2 win against the Falcons, including a historic day for Devin Lloyd (2:40) and Bryce Young balling out in Atlanta once again (9:30). Then, Cleveland Browns analyst for ESPN 850 Cleveland, Tony Grossi, joins the podcast to preview the game and take us inside Browns' fans feelings towards Deshaun Watson (20:40). title: Unease For Drake Maye, Breaking Down the Patriots’ Offensive Struggles
